name: wallet-search-for-etoro
description: Search eToro Wallet transactions and explore monthly statistics with a local history cache.

scripts.test:wallet:all: npm run build:wallet && npm run test:wallet && npm run test:wallet:e2e
scripts.format:wallet: prettier --write wallet-search scripts/*.mjs playwright.config.mjs package.json README.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.check:wallet:format: prettier --check wallet-search scripts/*.mjs playwright.config.mjs package.json README.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md .prettierrc.json
